&change.edit_ids {\n            if !referenced_edits.insert(edit_id.as_str()) || !edit_ids.contains(edit_id.as_str()) {\n                return Err(VcsError::ValidationFailed(format!(\"change {} has an invalid edit reference {edit_id}\", change.id)));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    let mut checkpoint_ids = HashSet::new();\n    for checkpoint in &envelope.vcs.checkpoints {\n        if !checkpoint_ids.insert(checkpoint.id.as_str()) {\n            return Err(VcsError::ValidationFailed(format!(\"history repeats authoritative checkpoint {}\", checkpoint.id)));\n        }\n    }\n    for checkpoint in &envelope.vcs.checkpoints {\n        let mut referenced_changes = HashSet::new();\n        for change_id in &checkpoint.change_ids {\n            if !referenced_changes.insert(change_id.as_str()) || !change_ids.contains(change_id.as_str()) {\n                return Err(VcsError::ValidationFailed(format!(\"checkpoint {} has an invalid change reference {change_id}\", checkpoint.id)));\n            }\n        }\n        if let Some(parent_id) = &checkpoint.parent_id {\n            if !checkpoint_ids.contains(parent_id.as_str()) || parent_id == &checkpoint.id {\n                return Err(VcsError::ValidationFailed(format!(\"checkpoint {} has an invalid parent reference {parent_id}\", checkpoint.id)));\n            }\n        }\n        validate_composition_pins(&checkpoint.composition_pins).await?;\n    }\n    let mut alternative_ids = HashSet::new();\n    for alternative in &envelope.vcs.alternatives {\n        if !alternative_ids.insert(alternative.id.as_str()) {\n            return Err(VcsError::ValidationFailed(format!(\"history repeats authoritative alternative {}\", alternative.id)));\n        }\n        let mut referenced_checkpoints = HashSet::new();\n        for checkpoint_id in &alternative.checkpoint_ids {\n            if !referenced_checkpoints.insert(checkpoint_id.as_str()) || !checkpoint_ids.contains(checkpoint_id.as_str()) {\n                return Err(VcsError::ValidationFailed(format!(\"alternative {} has an invalid checkpoint reference {checkpoint_id}\", alternative.id)));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    if let Some(active_alternative_id) = &envelope.active_alternative_id {\n        if !alternative_ids.contains(active_alternative_id.as_str()) {\n            return Err(VcsError::ValidationFailed(format!(\"history names an unknown active alternative {active_alternative_id}\")));\n        }\n    }\n    if let Some(cursor) = &envelope.cursor {\n        validate_history_lanes(envelope, &cursor.applied_edit_ids, &cursor.redo_edit_ids).await?;\n        if let Some(checkpoint_id) = &cursor.checkpoint_id {\n            if !checkpoint_ids.contains(checkpoint_id.as_str()) {\n                return Err(VcsError::ValidationFailed(format!(\"history cursor names an unknown checkpoint {checkpoint_id}\")));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nasync fn validate_history_lanes<P, Mutation, I, J, S, R>(envelope: &ArtifactEnvelope<P, Mutation>, applied_edit_ids: I, redo_edit_ids: J) -> Result<(), VcsError>\nwhere\n    I: IntoIterator<Item = S>,\n    J: IntoIterator<Item = R>,\n    S: AsRef<str>,\n    R: AsRef<str>,\n{\n    let known = envelope.vcs.edits.iter().map(|edit| edit.id.as_str()).collect::<HashSet<_>>();\n    let mut applied = HashSet::new();\n    for edit_id in applied_edit_ids {\n        let edit_id = edit_id.as_ref();\n        if !applied.insert(edit_id.to_string()) {\n            return Err(VcsError::ValidationFailed(format!(\"history repeats applied edit {edit_id}\")));\n        }\n        if !known.contains(edit_id) {\n            return Err(VcsError::UnknownEdit(edit_id.to_string()));\n        }\n    }\n    let mut redo = HashSet::new();\n    for edit_id in redo_edit_ids {\n        let edit_id = edit_id.as_ref();\n        if !redo.insert(edit_id.to_string()) {\n            return Err(VcsError::ValidationFailed(format!(\"history repeats redo edit {edit_id}\")));\n        }\n        if applied.contains(edit_id) {\n            return Err(VcsError::ValidationFailed(\"history places an edit in both applied and redo lanes\".to_string()));\n        }\n        if !known.contains(edit_id) {\n            return Err(VcsError::UnknownEdit(edit_id.to_string()));\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// 🎯️ Builds the binary op-log twin of `print_ops_log` — a `crate::os_spr::HistoryLog` carrying\n/// REAL Unlike the `.ops` text mirror (forwards-only, see\n/// `print_ops_log`'s doc), this is the AUTHORITATIVE persisted form: `parse_document_spr` recovers\n/// inverse/meta byte-for-byte instead of recomputing them via replay.\nasync fn history_op_payloads<Mutation: OpBinary>(mutations: &[Mutation]) -> Result<Vec<crate::os_spr::OpPayload>, VcsError> {\n    let mut payloads = Vec::with_capacity(mutations.len());\n    for op in mutations {\n        let binary = op.encode_op().map_err(|error| VcsError::Serialize(error.to_string()))?;\n        payloads.push(crate::os_spr::OpPayload { text: None, binary: Some(binary) });\n    }\n    Ok(payloads)\n}\n\n/// 🎯️ An empty `mutation_meta` (e.g. a hand-authored/externally-injected edit with no\n/// explicit meta, distinct from a real dispatch which always populates one entry per\n/// forward op) is treated as ABSENT, not as `Some(vec![])` — `encode_edit` requires\n/// `metas.len() == ops.len()` when meta is present at all, and an empty-but-`Some` vec\n/// would spuriously fail that check for a non-empty `ops`.\nasync fn history_edit_from_edit<Mutation: OpBinary>(edit: &Edit<Mutation>, messages: &[crate::os_spr::MutationMessage], lane: Option<HistoryLane>) -> Result<crate::os_spr::HistoryEdit, VcsError> {\n    if messages.iter().any(|message| message.op_index.is_none_or(|index| index as usize >= edit.forwards.len())) {\n        return Err(VcsError::ValidationFailed(format!(\"edit {} carries a message without a valid operation index\", edit.id)));\n    }\n    Ok(crate::os_spr::HistoryEdit {\n        id: edit.id.clone(),\n        actor: edit.actor.clone(),\n        started_at: edit.started_at.clone(),\n        finished_at: edit.finished_at.clone(),\n        description: edit.description.clone(), verb: edit.verb.clone(), line: edit.line.clone(),\n        ops: history_op_payloads(&edit.forwards).await?,\n        inverse: history_op_payloads(&edit.inverse).await?,\n        meta: if edit.mutation_meta.is_empty() {\n            if messages.is_empty() {\n                None\n            } else {\n                return Err(VcsError::ValidationFailed(format!(\"edit {} carries messages without operation metadata\", edit.id)));\n            }\n        } else {\n            Some(edit.mutation_meta.iter().enumerate().map(|(index, meta)| history_op_meta_from_operation_meta(meta, messages.iter().filter(move |message| message.op_index == Some(index as u32)).map(history_message_from_mutation_message))).collect())\n        },\n        lane: lane.filter(|lane| !matches!(lane, HistoryLane::Document)).map(|lane| match lane.to_value() {\n            crate::os_dsl::DslValue::String(name) => name,\n            other => unreachable!(\"a HistoryLane always encodes as its own camelCase word, got {other:?}\"),\n        }),\n    })\n}\n\n/// 🌀️ `encode_envelope` is async (📡️replication, out of this packet's scope); `map`'s\n/// closure is sync (R10 shape 1), so it's hoisted into an explicit loop.\nasync fn history_conflict_from_conflict(conflict: &crate::os_spr::Conflict) -> crate::os_spr::history::HistoryConflict {\n    let (kind, edit_ids, envelopes) = match &conflict.kind {\n        crate::os_spr::ConflictKind::Quarantined { envelopes, .. } => {\n            let mut encoded = Vec::with_capacity(envelopes.len());\n            for envelope in envelopes {\n                let mut bytes = Vec::new();\n                crate::os_spr::encode_envelope(envelope, &mut bytes);\n                encoded.push(bytes);\n            }\n            (0, Vec::new(), encoded)\n        }\n     status: match conflict.status {\n            crate::os_spr::ConflictStatus::Open => 0,\n            crate::os_spr::ConflictStatus::Accepted => 1,\n            crate::os_spr::ConflictStatus::Discarded => 2,\n        },\n        actors: conflict.actors.iter().map(|actor| actor.0.clone()).collect(),\n        hlt: (conflict.timestamp.actor, conflict.timestamp.physical_ms, conflict.timestamp.logical),\n        edit_ids,\n        envelopes,\n        messages: conflict.messages.iter().map(history_message_from_mutation_message).collect(),\n    }\n}\n\nfn conflict_from_history_conflict(conflict: crate::os_spr::history::HistoryConflict) -> Result<crate::os_spr::Conflict, String> {\n    let kind = match conflict.kind {\n        0 => {\n crate::os_spr::decode_envelope(&bytes, &mut position).map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;\n                if position != bytes.len() {\n                    return Err(\"quarantined conflict envelope has trailing bytes\".into());\n                }\n                envelopes.push(envelope);\n            }\n            crate::os_spr::ConflictKind::Quarantined { envelopes }\n        }\n        1 => crate::os_spr::ConflictKind::Degraded { edit_ids: conflict.edit_ids },\n        value => return Err(format!(\"unknown conflict kind {value}\")),\n    };\n    let status = match conflict.status {\n        0 => crate::os_spr::ConflictStatus::Open,\n        1 => crate::os_spr::ConflictStatus::Accepted,\n        2 => crate::os_spr::ConflictStatus::Discarded,\n        value => return Err(format!(\"unknown conflict status {value}\")),\n    };\n    Ok(crate::os_spr::Conflict {\n        id: crate::os_spr::ConflictId(conflict.id),\n        kind,\n        status,\n        messages: conflict.messages.into_iter().map(mutation_message_from_history_message).collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?,\n        actors: conflict.actors.into_iter().map(ActorId).collect(),\n        timestamp: HybridLogicalTimestamp { actor: conflict.hlt.0, physical_ms: conflict.hlt.1, logical: conflict.hlt.2 },\n    })\n}\n\n/// 🎯️ Encodes a bare, edit-free `.spr` op log for `schema` — the counterpart to a `.pack`\n/// file carrying only an initial snapshot with no history yet (e.g. a single dropped `.pack`\n/// file with no accompanying `.spr` sidecar). `doc_id` may be empty when the caller mints a fresh\n/// id downstream (as `parse_document_spr` never cross-checks it against the pack). LAW:\n/// `parse_document_spr(pack, &empty_document_spr(id, schema))` recovers exactly `P::decode_pack(pack)`\n/// as both the initial and live snapshot, with zero edits.\npub async fn empty_document_spr(doc_id: &str, schema: &str) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let log = crate::os_spr::HistoryLog { doc_id: doc_id.to_string(), schema: schema.to_string(), ..crate::os_spr::HistoryLog::default() };\n    crate::os_spr::encode_history(&log, &crate::os_spr::EncodeOptions::default()).await.expect(\"encoding an edit-free HistoryLog is infallible\")\n}\n\n/// 🪪️ Re-stamps an app-built document builds that log without knowing\n/// where its store is mounted, and archive hydration rejects any log whose identity differs.\npub async fn stamp_document_spr_identity(spr: &[u8], doc_id: &str, schema: &str, dialect: &crate::os_io::ArtifactDialect, owner: Option<&OwnerRef>) -> Result<Vec<u8>, VcsError> {\n    let mut log = crate::os_spr::decode_history(spr, &crate::os_spr::DecodeOptions::default()).await.map_err(|error| VcsError::Deserialize(error.to_string()))?;\n    log.doc_id = doc_id.to_string();\n    log.schema = schema.to_string();\n    log.composition = Some(crate::os_spr::HistoryComposition {\n        owner: owner.map(|owner| (owner.parent.to_uri(), owner.slot.clone(), owner.child_id.clone())),\n        dialect: Some((dialect.artifact_kind.clone(), dialect.standard.clone(), dialect.subset.clone())),\n    });\n    let options = crate::os_spr::EncodeOptions { write_backwards_section: true, ..crate::os_spr::EncodeOptions::default() };\n    crate::os_spr::encode_history(&log, &options).await.map_err(|error| VcsError::Serialize(error.to_string()))\n}\n\n/// 🌱️ A brand-new owned member's full envelope pack — `initial_pack` plus an edit-free `.spr`\n/// stamped with the child's id, `schema`, `dialect` and `owner` through the same\n/// `stamp_document_spr_identity` path a parent's own whole-document load takes — in exactly the\n/// `encode_document_pack_bytes` framing `MemberFactory::open` and archive member admission accept.\n/// Minted from bytes alone, never through a live `ArtifactStore`, so a caller completing a closure\n/// (`VcsArtifactApp`'s derivable-child genesis) owes no bounded close protocol for it.\npub async fn genesis_member_envelope_pack(schema: &str, dialect: &crate::os_io::ArtifactDialect, owner: &OwnerRef, initial_pack: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, VcsError> {\n    if initial_pack.is_empty() {\n        return Err(VcsError::Deserialize(format!(\"child genesis for {} carries an empty initial pack\", owner.child_id)));\n    }\n    let spr = stamp_document_spr_identity(&empty_document_spr(&owner.child_id, schema).await, &owner.child_id, schema, dialect, Some(owner)).await?;\n    Ok(encode_document_pack_bytes(initial_pack, &spr).await)\n}\n\n/// ➕️ Appends `edits` and `transitions` to an already-encoded append_history_events_to_spr(spr: &[u8], edits: &[crate::os_spr::HistoryEdit], transitions: &[crate::os_spr::HistoryTransitionRecord]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, VcsError> {\n    let mut log = crate::os_spr::decode_history(spr, &crate::os_spr::DecodeOptions::default()).await.map_err(|error| VcsError::Deserialize(error.to_string()))?;\n    log.edits.extend(edits.iter().cloned());\n    log.transitions.extend(transitions.iter().cloned());\n    let options = crate::os_spr::EncodeOptions { write_backwards_section: true, ..crate::os_spr::EncodeOptions::default() };\n    crate::os_spr::encode_history(&log, &options).await.map_err(|error| VcsError::Serialize(error.to_string()))\n}\n\n/// 🧩️ Projects an envelope's composition facts (`owner`, `dialect`) into the record existing. `ArtifactRef`s cross the boundary as their `to_uri()`\n/// wire string, the same \"own the codec at this edge\" convention `CompositionPin`/`ArtifactChild`\n/// already use rather than coupling `ArtifactRef` into the protocol crate.\nasync fn history_composition_from_envelope<P, Mutation>(envelope: &ArtifactEnvelopeOwners<P, Mutation>) -> envelope.dialect.as_ref().map(|dialect| (dialect.artifact_kind.clone(), dialect.standard.clone(), dialect.subset.clone()));\n    if owner.is_none() && dialect.is_none() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    Some(crate::os_spr::HistoryComposition { owner, dialect })\n}\n\n/// 🧩️ Inverse of `history_composition_from_envelope`: malformed ownership rejects the\n/// authoritative history rather than ArtifactEnvelope<P, Mutation>, composition: &crate::os_spr::HistoryComposition) -> Result<(), VcsError> {\n    envelope.owner = match &composition.owner {\n        Some((parent, slot, child_id)) => envelope.dialect = composition.dialect.as_ref().map(|(artifact_kind, standard, subset)| crate::os_io::ArtifactDialect { artifact_kind: artifact_kind.clone(), standard: standard.clone(), subset: subset.clone() });\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// 🌀️ `history_conflict_from_conflict` is async (calls the 📡️replication `encode_envelope`);\n/// `Iterator::map`'s closure is sync (R10 shape 1), so it's hoisted into an explicit loop.\npub async fn print_document_spr<P, Mutation>(envelope: &ArtifactEnvelopeOwners<P, Mutation>) -> Result<Vec<u8>, VcsError>\nwhere\n    Mutation: OpBinary,\n{\n    validate_persisted_conflicts(envelope).await?;\n    let mut message_ledger = BTreeMap::new();\n    for entry in envelope.edit_messages.iter().filter(|entry| envelope.holds_committed_edit(&entry.edit_id)) {\n        if message_ledger.insert(entry.edit_id.as_str(), entry.messages.as_slice()).is_some() {\n            return Err(VcsError::ValidationFailed(format!(\"duplicate message ledger for edit {}\", entry.edit_id)));\n        }\n        if !envelope.vcs.edits.iter().any(|edit| edit.id == entry.edit_id) {\n            return Err(VcsError::ValidationFailed(format!(\"message ledger references unknown edit {}\", entry.edit_id)));\n        }\n        let operation_count = envelope.vcs.edits.find_near(|edit| edit.id == entry.edit_id).map(|edit| edit.forwards.len()).ok_or_else(|| VcsError::ValidationFailed(format!(\"message ledger references unknown edit {}\", entry.edit_id)))?;\n        if entry.messages.is_empty() validate_persisted_message(message, Some(operation_count)).await?;\n        }\n    }\n    let mut edits = Vec::with_capacity(envelope.vcs.edits.len());\n    for edit in message_ledger.get(edit.id.as_str()).copied().unwrap_or(&[]), envelope.lanes.get(&edit.id).copied()).await?);\n    }\n    let mut conflicts = Vec::with_capacity(envelope.conflicts.len());\n    for history_composition_from_envelope(envelope).await,\n        conflicts,\n        viewer_line: envelope.active_alternative_id.clone().filter(|line| line != &crate::os_spr::trunk_alternative_id(&ArtifactId(envelope.id.clone()))),\n        viewer_checkpoint: envelope.viewer_checkpoint_id.clone(),\n    };\n    let options = crate::os_spr::EncodeOptions { write_backwards_section: true, ..crate::os_spr::EncodeOptions::default() };\n    crate::os_spr::encode_history(&log, &options).await.map_err(|error| VcsError::Serialize(error.to_string()))\n}\n\n/// 🎯️ Inverse of [`print_document_spr`]: rebuilds an envelope's event log — `edits` (with\n/// their persisted `inverse`/`mutation_meta`) and `transitions` — from a decoded `HistoryLog`, then\n/// folds The initial\n/// snapshot comes from `pack` via `ArtifactPack::decode_pack`, matching `parse_document_pack`'s contract.\npub async fn parse_document_spr<P, Mutation>(pack: &[u8], spr: &[u8]) -> Result<ParsedDocumentText<P, Mutation>, TextError>\nwhere\n    P: Clone + ArtifactPack,\n    Mutation: OpText + OpBinary + self::Mutation<P>,\n{\n    let log = crate::os_spr::decode_history(spr, &crate::os_spr::DecodeOptions::default()).await.map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,error.to_string(),TextSpan::at(1, 1)))?;\n    parse_decoded_document_spr(pack, log).await\n}\n\n/// 🧊️ The validation replay's final projection is a SCRATCH value nothing below reads — the\n/// authoritative one is rebuilt from the cursor further down. of a generation3d document\n/// with a layout entry died in `OrderedMap<WidgetLayout>::drop`\n/// (ticket 26/09/09/PROCEDURAL-3D-END-TO-END). `ReplayProjection` now retires it on every early\n/// `?` above as well, which the explicit call below never covered.\npub async fn parse_decoded_document_spr<P, Mutation>(pack: &[u8], mut log: crate::os_spr::HistoryLog) -> Result<ParsedDocumentText<P, Mutation>, TextError>\nwhere\n    P: Clone + ArtifactPack,\n    Mutation: OpText + OpBinary + self::Mutation<P>,\n{\n    let initial_snapshot = P::decode_pack(pack).map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,error.to_string(),TextSpan::at(1, 1)))?;\n\n    async fn decode_op<P, Mutation: OpText + OpBinary + self::Mutation<P>>(payload: &crate::os_spr::OpPayload) -> Result<Mutation, TextError> {\n        match (&payload.binary, &payload.text) {\n            (Some(bytes), _) => Mutation::decode_op(bytes).map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,error.to_string(),TextSpan::at(1, 1))),\n            (None, Some(text)) => Mutation::parse_op(text),\n            (None, None) => Err(TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,\"op payload carries neither binary nor text\".to_string(),TextSpan::at(1, 1))),\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn decode_ops<P, Mutation: OpText + OpBinary + self::Mutation<P>>(payloads: &[crate::os_spr::OpPayload]) -> Result<Vec<Mutation>, TextError> {\n        let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(payloads.len());\n in log.edits.into_iter().enumerate() {\n        let edit_id = history_edit.id.clone();\n        if let Some(lane) = &history_edit.lane {\n            let lane = unknown lane: {error}\"),TextSpan::at(1, 1)))?;\n            if !lane.is_document().await {\n                lanes.insert(edit_id.clone(), lane);\n            }\n        }\n        let forwards = decode_ops::<P, Mutation>(&history_edit.ops).await?;\n        let inverse = decode_ops::<P, Mutation>(&history_edit.inverse).await?;\n        let metas = history_edit.meta.ok_or_else(|| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,format!(\"history edit {edit_id} has no authoritative operation metadata\"),TextSpan::at(1, 1)))?;\n        if metas.len() != forwards.len() {\n            return Err(TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,format!(\"history edit {edit_id} has {} metadata entries for {} forward operations\", !durable_messages.is_empty() {\n            edit_messages.push(crate::os_spr::EditMessages { edit_id: edit_id.clone(), messages: durable_messages });\n        }\n        let mut edit = Edit {\n            id: history_edit.id,\n            actor: history_edit.actor,\n            forwards,\n            inverse,\n            mutation_meta,\n            description: history_edit.description, verb: history_edit.verb, line: history_edit.line,\n            sequence_number: index as i32 + 1,\n            started_at: history_edit.started_at,\n            finished_at: history_edit.finished_at,\n        };\n        stamp_edit_semantics::<P, Mutation>(&mut edit, &schema);\n        edits.push(edit);\n    }\n\n    let mut conflicts = Vec::with_capacity(log.conflicts.len());\n    for conflict in std::mem::take(&mut log.conflicts) {\n        conflicts.push(conflict_from_history_conflict(conflict).map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,error,TextSpan::at(1, 1)))?);\n    }\n    let edits = ArtifactHistoryLedger::try_from_preflighted(edits).map_err(|_| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::OwnershipLimit,\"history edit capacity exceeded\".to_string(),TextSpan::at(1, 1)))?;\n    let mut transitions: Vec<crate::os_spr::MutationEnvelope> = log.transitions.iter().map(|record| record.to_envelope(&log.doc_id)).collect();\n    transitions.sort_by(|left, right| (left.timestamp.cmp_key(), left.mutation_id.0.as_str()).cmp(&(right.timestamp.cmp_key(), right.mutation_id.0.as_str())));\n    let mut envelope = ArtifactEnvelope::from_owners(ArtifactEnvelopeOwners {\n        schema: log.schema,\n        id: log.doc_id,\n        vcs: ArtifactVcs { initial_snapshot, edits, changes: ArtifactHistoryLedger::new(), checkpoints: ArtifactHistoryLedger::new(), alternatives: ArtifactHistoryLedger::new() },\n        backbone: None,\n        active_alternative_id: None,\n        cursor: None,\n        dialect: None,\n        migrated_from: None,\n        owner: None,\n        lanes,\n        edit_messages: ArtifactEditMessageLedger::from_preflighted_entries(edit_messages),\n        conflicts,\n        transitions,\n        history_shape: crate::os_spr::HistoryShape::Document,\n        open_transaction: None,\n        viewer_checkpoint_id: None,\n    });\n    let trunk = crate::os_spr::trunk_alternative_id(&ArtifactId(envelope.id.clone()));\n    envelope.active_alternative_id = log.viewer_line.clone().filter(|line| line != &trunk);\n    envelope.viewer_checkpoint_id = log.viewer_checkpoint.clone();\n    let composed = match &log.composition {\n        Some(composition) => apply_history_composition(&mut envelope, composition).await.map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,error.to_string(),TextSpan::at(1, 1))),\n        None => Ok(()),\n    };\n    match composed {\n        Ok(()) => settle_parsed_envelope(envelope).await,\n        Err(error) => {\n            discard_parsed_envelope(envelope);\n            Err(error)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 📤️ Pack counterpart of `print_document_text`: identical op-log TEXT body (`print_ops_log`)\n/// for the human-readable mirror, but the initial snapshot is encoded to pack bytes\n/// (`ArtifactPack::encode_pack`) instead of printed to DSL text — plus the AUTHORITATIVE `.spr`\n/// binary op log (`print_document_spr`), which carries real inverse/binary payloads/cursor.\npub async fn print_document_pack<P, Mutation>(envelope: &ArtifactEnvelopeOwners<P, Mutation>) -> Result<ArtifactPackFiles, VcsError>\nwhere\n    P: ArtifactPack,\n    Mutation: OpText + OpBinary,\n{\n    let pack = envelope.vcs.initial_snapshot.encode_pack();\n    let spr = print_document_spr(envelope).await?;\n    let ops = print_ops_log(envelope).await?;\n    Ok(ArtifactPackFiles { pack, spr, ops })\n}\n\n/// 📥️ Parses the explicit `.ops` records against an already-obtained initial snapshot.\n/// Text persistence is intentionally strict: it requires inverse operations, one authoritative\n/// metadata record per forward operation, durable messages/conflicts, and exactly one cursor.\nasync fn replay_ops<P, Mutation>(initial_snapshot: P, ops: &str) -> Result<ParsedDocumentText<P, Mutation>, TextError>\nwhere\n    P: Clone,\n    Mutation: OpText + OpBinary + self::Mutation<P>,\n{\n    let mut schema = String::new();\n    let mut id = String::new();\n    let mut edits: Vec<Edit<Mutation>> = Vec::new();\n    let mut transitions: Vec<crate::os_spr::MutationEnvelope> = Vec::new();\n    let mut inverse_by_edit: HashMap<String, Vec<Mutation>> = HashMap::new();\n    let mut metadata_by_edit: HashMap<String, HashMap<u32, MutationMeta>> = HashMap::new();\n    let mut messages_by_edit: HashMap<String, Vec<crate::os_spr::MutationMessage>> = HashMap::new();\n    let mut message_order = Vec::new();\n    let mut conflicts = Vec::new();\n    let mut saw_doc = false;\n\n    struct PendingEdit {\n        id: String,\n        sequence_number: i32,\n        actor: Option<String>,\n        started_at: String,\n        finished_at: Option<String>,\n        description: Option<String>,\n        verb: Option<String>,\n        line: Option<String>,\n    }\n    let mut pending_edit: Option<PendingEdit> = None;\n    let mut pending_forwards: Vec<Mutation> = Vec::new();\n\n    let flush_pending_edit = |pending_edit: &mut Option<PendingEdit>, pending_forwards: &mut Vec<Mutation>, edits: &mut Vec<Edit<Mutation>>| -> Result<(), TextError> {\n        let Some(header) = pending_edit.take() else {\n            return Ok(());\n        };\n        let forwards = std::mem::take(pending_forwards);\n        edits.push(Edit {\n            id: header.id,\n            actor: header.actor,\n            forwards,\n            inverse: Vec::new(),\n            mutation_meta: Vec::new(),\n            description: header.description, verb: header.verb, line: header.line,\n            sequence_number: header.sequence_number,\n            started_at: header.started_at,\n            finished_at: header.finished_at,\n        });\n        Ok(())\n    };\n\n    for (index, raw_line) in ops.lines().enumerate() {\n        let line_no = index as u32 + 1;\n        let trimmed = raw_line.trim();\n        if trimmed.is_empty() || trimmed.starts_with('#') {\n            continue;\n        }\n        if raw_line.starts_with(\"  \") && pending_edit.is_some() {\n            let operation = Mutation::parse_op(trimmed).map_err(|error| TextError { span: TextSpan::at(line_no, error.span.column), ..error })?;\n            pending_forwards.push(operation);\n            continue;\n        }\n        flush_pending_edit(&mut pending_edit, &mut pending_forwards, &mut edits)?;\n        let line = OpsHeaderLine::parse_op(trimmed).map_err(|error| TextError { span: TextSpan::at(line_no, error.span.column), ..error })?;\n        match line {\n            OpsHeaderLine::Doc { id: doc_id, schema: doc_schema } => {\n                if saw_doc {\n                    return Err(TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,\"ops text repeats its document header\".to_string(),TextSpan::at(line_no, 1)));\n                }\n                saw_doc = true;\n                schema = doc_schema;\n                id = doc_id;\n            }\n            OpsHeaderLine::Edit { id: edit_id, sequence, started, actor, finished, description, verb, line } => {\n                if edits.iter().any(|edit| edit.id == edit_id) || pending_edit.as_ref().is_some_and(|edit| edit.id == edit_id) {\n                    return Err(TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,format!(\"ops text repeats edit {edit_id}\"),TextSpan::at(line_no, 1)));\n                }\n                pending_edit = Some(PendingEdit { id: edit_id, sequence_number: sequence, actor, started_at: started, finished_at: finished, description, verb, line: ops_line_provenance(line)? });\n                pending_forwards = Vec::new();\n            }\n            OpsHeaderLine::Revert { id: transition_id, actor, clock, after, operations } => {\n                transitions.push(transition_from_ops_line(&id, transition_id, actor, &clock, after, crate::os_spr::HistoryTransition::Revert { mutation_ids: mutation_ids(operations) }).map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,error,TextSpan::at(line_no, 1)))?);\n            }\n            OpsHeaderLine::Reinstate { id: transition_id, actor, clock, after, operations } => {\n                transitions.push(transition_from_ops_line(&id, transition_id, actor, &clock, after, crate::os_spr::HistoryTransition::Reinstate { mutation_ids: mutation_ids(operations) }).map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,error,TextSpan::at(line_no, 1)))?);\n            }\n            OpsHeaderLine::Commit { id: transition_id, actor, clock, after, checkpoint, parent, change, operations, description, saved, by, message, at, line } => {\n                let authors = by.into_iter().map(|author| crate::os_spr::TransitionAuthor { id: author.id, name: author.name, avatar: author.avatar }).collect();\n                let checkpoint = crate::os_spr::TransitionCheckpoint { checkpoint_id: checkpoint, parent_id: parent, change_id: change, mutation_ids: mutation_ids(operations), description, saved_at: saved, authors, message, timestamp: at, line_id: ops_line_provenance(line)? };\n                transitions.push(transition_from_ops_line(&id, transition_id, actor, &clock, after, crate::os_spr::HistoryTransition::Commit(checkpoint)).map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,error,TextSpan::at(line_no, 1)))?);\n            }\n            OpsHeaderLine::Branch { id: transition_id, actor, clock, after, alternative, name, checkpoint } => {\n                transitions.push(transition_from_ops_line(&id, transition_id, actor, &clock, after, crate::os_spr::HistoryTransition::Branch { alternative_id: alternative, name, checkpoint_id: checkpoint }).map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,error,TextSpan::at(line_no, 1)))?);\n            }\n            OpsHeaderLine::Checkout { id: transition_id, actor, clock, after, checkpoint, alternative } => {\n                transitions.push(transition_from_ops_line(&id, transition_id, actor, &clock, after, crate::os_spr::HistoryTransition::Checkout { checkpoint_id: checkpoint, alternative_id: alternative }).map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,error,TextSpan::at(line_no, 1)))?);\n            }\n            OpsHeaderLine::Repin { id: transition_id, actor, clock, after, checkpoint, pinned, pins } => {\n                let pins = pins.into_iter().map(|pin| crate::os_spr::TransitionPin { child_uri: pin.child, checkpoint_id: pin.checkpoint }).collect();\n                transitions.push(transition_from_ops_line(&id, transition_id, actor, &clock, after, crate::os_spr::HistoryTransition::Repin { checkpoint_id: checkpoint, pinned_checkpoint_id: pinned, pins }).map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,error,TextSpan::at(line_no, 1)))?);\n            }\n            OpsHeaderLine::Supersede { id: transition_id, actor, clock, after, scope, inputs, observed } => {\n                let inputs = inputs.into_iter().map(crate::os_spr::SupersededInput::try_from).collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>().map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,error,TextSpan::at(line_no, 1)))?;\n                let supersede = crate::os_spr::TransitionSupersede { scope, inputs };\n                supersede.validate().map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,error.to_string(),TextSpan::at(line_no, 1)))?;\n                let mut envelope = transition_from_ops_line(&id, transition_id, actor, &clock, after, crate::os_spr::HistoryTransition::Supersede(supersede)).map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,error,TextSpan::at(line_no, 1)))?;\n                envelope.observed = observed.map(MutationId);\n                transitions.push(envelope);\n            }\n            OpsHeaderLine::Inverse { edit, ops } => {\n                let mut inverse = Vec::with_capacity(ops.len());\n                for operation in &ops {\n                    inverse.push(Mutation::parse_op(operation).map_err(|error| TextError { span: TextSpan::at(line_no, error.span.column), ..error })?);\n                }\n                if inverse_by_edit.insert(edit.clone(), inverse).is_some() {\n                    return Err(TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,format!(\"ops text repeats inverse record for edit {edit}\"),TextSpan::at(line_no, 1)));\n                }\n            }\n            OpsHeaderLine::Metadata { edit, index, data } => {\n                let metadata = semio_framework_pack_json::from_json_str(&data, semio_framework_pack_json::JsonMemberPolicy::Reject).map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,format!(\"invalid metadata record for edit {edit}: {error}\"),TextSpan::at(line_no, 1)))?;\n                if metadata_by_edit.entry(edit.clone()).or_default().insert(index, metadata).is_some() {\n                    return Err(TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,format!(\"ops text repeats metadata index {index} for edit {edit}\"),TextSpan::at(line_no, 1)));\n                }\n            }\n            OpsHeaderLine::Message { edit, data } => {\n                let message = semio_framework_pack_json::from_json_str(&data, semio_framework_pack_json::JsonMemberPolicy::Reject).map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,format!(\"invalid message record for edit {edit}: {error}\"),TextSpan::at(line_no, 1)))?;\n                if !messages_by_edit.contains_key(&edit) {\n                    message_order.push(edit.clone());\n                }\n                messages_by_edit.entry(edit).or_default().push(message);\n            }\n            OpsHeaderLine::Conflict { data } => {\n                let conflict = semio_framework_pack_json::from_json_str(&data, semio_framework_pack_json::JsonMemberPolicy::Reject).map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,format!(\"invalid conflict record: {error}\"),TextSpan::at(line_no, 1)))?;\n                conflicts.push(conflict);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    flush_pending_edit(&mut pending_edit, &mut pending_forwards, &mut edits)?;\n    if !saw_doc {\n        return Err(TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,\"ops text has no document header\".to_string(),TextSpan::at(1, 1)));\n    }\n    for edit in &mut edits {\n        edit.inverse = inverse_by_edit.remove(&edit.id).ok_or_else(|| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,format!(\"ops text has no inverse record for edit {}\", edit.id),TextSpan::at(1, 1)))?;\n        let metadata = metadata_by_edit.remove(&edit.id).ok_or_else(|| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,format!(\"ops text has no metadata records for edit {}\", edit.id),TextSpan::at(1, 1)))?;\n        if metadata.len() != edit.forwards.len() || (0..edit.forwards.len() as u32).any(|index| !metadata.contains_key(&index)) {\n            return Err(TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,format!(\"ops text metadata does not exactly cover edit {}\", edit.id),TextSpan::at(1, 1)));\n        }\n        edit.mutation_meta =\n            (0..edit.forwards.len() as u32).map(|index| metadata.get(&index).cloned().ok_or_else(|| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,format!(\"ops text metadata is missing index {index} for edit {}\", edit.id),TextSpan::at(1, 1)))).collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;\n        stamp_edit_semantics::<P, Mutation>(edit, &schema);\n    }\n    if let Some(edit) = inverse_by_edit.keys().next() {\n        return Err(TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,format!(\"ops text has an inverse for unknown edit {edit}\"),TextSpan::at(1, 1)));\n    }\n    if let Some(edit) = metadata_by_edit.keys().next() {\n        return Err(TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,format!(\"ops text has metadata for unknown edit {edit}\"),TextSpan::at(1, 1)));\n    }\n    let mut edit_messages = Vec::new();\n    for edit_id in message_order {\n        let messages = messages_by_edit.remove(&edit_id).ok_or_else(|| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvariantViolated,format!(\"ops text lost message ownership for edit {edit_id}\"),TextSpan::at(1, 1)))?;\n        let edit = edits.iter().find(|edit| edit.id == edit_id).ok_or_else(|| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,format!(\"ops text has messages for unknown edit {edit_id}\"),TextSpan::at(1, 1)))?;\n        for message in &messages {\n            validate_persisted_message(message, Some(edit.forwards.len())).await.map_err(|error| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,error.to_string(),TextSpan::at(1, 1)))?;\n        }\n        edit_messages.push(crate::os_spr::EditMessages { edit_id, messages });\n    }\n    let edits = ArtifactHistoryLedger::try_from_preflighted(edits).map_err(|_| TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::OwnershipLimit,\"ops edit capacity exceeded\".to_string(),TextSpan::at(1, 1)))?;\n    transitions.sort_by(|left, right| (left.timestamp.cmp_key(), left.mutation_id.0.as_str()).cmp(&(right.timestamp.cmp_key(), right.mutation_id.0.as_str())));\n    let envelope = ArtifactEnvelope::from_owners(ArtifactEnvelopeOwners {\n        schema,\n        id,\n        vcs: ArtifactVcs { initial_snapshot, edits, changes: ArtifactHistoryLedger::new(), checkpoints: ArtifactHistoryLedger::new(), alternatives: ArtifactHistoryLedger::new() },\n        backbone: None,\n        active_alternative_id: None,\n        cursor: None,\n        dialect: None,\n        migrated_from: None,\n        owner: None,\n        lanes: BTreeMap::new(),\n        edit_messages: ArtifactEditMessageLedger::from_preflighted_entries(edit_messages),\n        conflicts,\n        transitions,\n        history_shape: crate::os_spr::HistoryShape::Document,\n        open_transaction: None,\n        viewer_checkpoint_id: None,\n    });\n    settle_parsed_envelope(envelope).await\n}\n\n/// 🧮️ Finishes a load: folds the parsed event log into every derived position and fact,\n/// validates the result and materializes the live snapshot by replaying the applied edits over the\n/// genesis. A refused document is discarded through [`discard_parsed_envelope`], never dropped.\nasync fn settle_parsed_envelope<P, Mutation>(mut envelope: ArtifactEnvelope<P, Mutation>) -> Result<ParsedDocumentText<P, Mutation>, TextError>\nwhere\n    P: Clone,\n    Mutation: self::Mutation<P> + OpBinary,\n{\n    let settled = match project_envelope_history(&mut envelope) {\n        Ok(supersessions) => validate_durable_history(&envelope).await.map(|()| supersessions),\n        Err(error) => Err(error),\n    };\n    let snapshot = match settled {\n        Ok(supersessions) => {\n            let applied_edit_ids = envelope.cursor.as_ref().map(|cursor| cursor.applied_edit_ids.clone()).unwrap_or_default();\n            replay_loaded_history(&mut envelope, &applied_edit_ids, supersessions)\n        }\n        Err(error) => Err(error),\n    };\n    match snapshot {\n        Ok(snapshot) => Ok(ParsedDocumentText { envelope, snapshot }),\n        Err(error) => {\n            discard_parsed_envelope(envelope);\n            Err(TextError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue,error.to_string(),TextSpan::at(1, 1)))\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 🧹️ Discards a refused, never-published parsed envelope: its shell is detached and its\n/// genesis retired through the technology's own diff vocabulary; the plain history data drops.\nfn discard_parsed_envelope<P, Mutation>(envelope: ArtifactEnvelope<P, Mutation>)\nwhere\n    Mutation: self::Mutation<P>,\n{\n    let mut owners = envelope.into_owners();\n    while owners.vcs.edits.pop().is_some() {}\n    while owners.vcs.changes.pop().is_some() {}\n    while owners.vcs.checkpoints.pop().is_some() {}\n    while owners.vcs.alternatives.pop().is_some() {}\n    while owners.edit_messages.pop().is_some() {}\n    retire_replayed_projection::<P, Mutation>(owners.vcs.initial_snapshot);\n}\n\n/// 📥️ Parses the textual VCS document back into an envelope plus its live (fully-replayed)\n/// snapshot — obtains the initial snapshot via `P::parse_dsl` then shares `replay_ops`.\npub async fn parse_document_text<P, Mutation>(dsl: &str, ops: &str) -> Result<ParsedDocumentText<P, Mutation>, TextError>\nwhere\n    P: Clone + ArtifactDsl,\n    Mutation: OpText + OpBinary + self::Mutation<P>,\n{\n    let initial_snapshot = P::parse_dsl(dsl)?;\n    replay_ops(initial_snapshot, ops).await\n}\n\n/// 📥️ spr-first pack counterpart of `parse_document_text`: pack+spr are the AUTHORITATIVE\n/// pair (see `ArtifactPackFiles`'s doc) — this is a thin forward onto `parse_document_spr`, which\n/// recovers real `inverse`/`mutation_meta`/`cursor` instead of recomputing them via replay.\npub async fn parse_document_pack<P, Mutation>(pack: &[u8], spr: &[u8]) -> Result<ParsedDocumentText<P, Mutation>, TextError>\nwhere\n    P: Clone + ArtifactPack,\n    Mutation: OpText + OpBinary + self::Mutation<P>,\n{\n    parse_document_spr(pack, spr).await\n}\n//#endregion 🔖️TextFormat\n\n//#region 🔖️CommandFormat\nmod operation_envelope_serde {\n    /// 🧵️ `ToValue` twin of the former `serialize` — identical byte framing, wire shape is\n    /// `DslValue::Array` of `DslValue::Number` (one per byte), matching `Vec<u8>`'s own\n    /// `ToValue` codec exactly (so this is equivalent to `ToValue::to_value(&bytes)`).\n    pub fn to_value(envelope: &crate::os_spr::MutationEnvelope) -> crate::os_dsl::DslValue {\n        let mut bytes = Vec::new();\n        crate::os_spr::encode_envelope(envelope, &mut bytes);\n        crate::os_dsl::ToValue::to_value(&bytes)\n    }\n\n    /// 🧵️ `FromValue` twin of `to_value` above.\n    pub fn from_value(value: crate::os_dsl::DslValue) -> Result<crate::os_spr::MutationEnvelope, crate::os_dsl::ValueError> {\n        let bytes: Vec<u8> = crate::os_dsl::FromValue::from_value(value)?;\n        let mut pos = 0;\n        crate::os_spr::decode_envelope(&bytes, &mut pos).map_err(|error| crate::os_dsl::ValueError::new(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::InvalidValue, error.to_string()))\n    }\n}\n\n/// 🕹️ One structural `ArtifactCommand` line — `apply`/`undo`/`redo`/`commit-checkpoint`/\n/// `create-alternative`/`switch-alternative`/`checkout` — the command-level twin of\n/// `OpsHeaderLine`, re-derived on the same `dsl_schema` grammar engine. `Apply` carries no\n/// operations here (those follow as 2-space-indented `Op::print_op` lines, exactly like\n/// `print_edit_lines`); `Undo`'s `policy` is `None` for the plain `undo` command and `Some(token)`\n/// for `UndoWithPolicy` (token = kebab of the `UndoPolicy` variant name), optionally followed by an\n/// indented nested command block for `semantic-undo`/`compensating-action`.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, DslOps)]\nenum CommandHeaderLine {\n    /// ▶️ `transaction`/`tool` are the [`protocol::TransactionRef`] halves, present together or not at all.\n    Apply {\n        description: Option<String>,\n        transaction: Option<String>,\n        tool: Option<String>,\n    },\n    Undo {\n        policy: Option<String>,\n    },\n    Redo,\n    CommitCheckpoint {\n        message: Option<String>,\n        by: Vec<OpsAuthor>,\n    },\n    CreateAlternative {\n        name: String,\n    },\n    SwitchAlternative {\n        #[dsl(positional)]\n        id: String,\n    },\n    Checkout {\n        #[dsl(positional)]\n        id: String,\n    },\n    PruneDrafts,\n    /// 🛤️ Text twin of `ArtifactCommand::ApplyInLane` — `lane` is a kebab token\n    /// (`history_lane_to_token`/`parse_history_lane_token`), matching `Undo.policy`'s convention.\n    ApplyInLane {\n        description: Option<String>,\n        lane: String,\n        transaction: Option<String>,\n        tool: Option<String>,\n    },\n    UndoInLane {\n        lane: String,\n    },\n    RedoInLane {\n        lane: String,\n    },\n    /// ⚖️ Text twin of `ArtifactCommand::SetMergePolicy` — `policy` is a kebab token\n    /// (`merge_policy_to_token`/`parse_merge_policy_token`), matching `Undo.policy`'s convention.\n    SetMergePolicy {\n        policy: String,\n    },\n    /// ⚔️ Text twin of `ArtifactCommand::ResolveConflict` — `resolution` is a kebab token\n    /// (`conflict_resolution_to_token`/`parse_conflict_resolution_token`).\n    ResolveConflict {\n        #[dsl(positional)]\n        conflict_id: String,\n        resolution: String,\n    },\n    /// ✏️ Text twin of `ArtifactCommand::Supersede`; its inputs follow as [`SupersedeInputLine`]s.\n    Supersede {\n        scope: Option<String>,\n    },\n    /// 🌿️ Text twin of `ArtifactCommand::CreateAlternativeWithSupersede`; its inputs follow as [`SupersedeInputLine`]s.\n    CreateAlternativeWithSupersede {\n        name: String,\n    },\n    /// 🎞️ Text twin of `ArtifactCommand::AppendTransaction` — the [`protocol::TransactionRef`] halves; its operations follow\n    /// as indented op lines.\n    AppendTransaction {\n        transaction: String,\n        tool: String,\n    },\n    /// ✅️ Text twin of `ArtifactCommand::CommitTransaction`.\n    CommitTransaction {\n        #[dsl(positional)]\n        id: String,\n    },\n    /// 🧨️ Text twin of `ArtifactCommand::AbortTransaction`.\n    AbortTransaction {\n        #[dsl(positional)]\n        id: String,\n    },\n}\n\n/// ✏️ One 2-space-indented input line under a `supersede` command: `replace <target>` followed by the replacement's\n/// 4-space-indented `print_op` line, or `withdraw <target>`.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, DslOps)]\nenum SupersedeInputLine {\n    Replace {\n        #[dsl(positional)]\n        target: String,\n    },\n    Withdraw {\n        #[dsl(positional)]\n        target: String,\n    },\n}\n\nimpl OpText for SupersedeInputLine {\n    fn parse_op(line: &str) -> Result<Self, TextError> {\n        let variants = <Self as crate::os_dsl::DslVariants>::variants();\n        for (keyword, spec_fn) in &variants {\n            let probe = format!(\"{} \", keyword);\n            if line == keyword.as_str() || line.starts_with(&probe) {\n                let record = crate::os_dsl::parse(line, &(spec_fn.ordinary)(), &crate::os_dsl::ParseOptions { limits: semio_framework_diagnostic::Limits::default(), mode: crate::os_dsl::SourceMode::Inline })?;\n                return <Self as crate::os_dsl::DslVariants>::from_named_record(keyword, &record);\n            }\n        }\n        Err(crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(format!(\"unknown supersede input line '{line}'\")))\n    }\n    fn print_op(&self) -> String {\n        let (keyword, record) = <Self as crate::os_dsl::DslVariants>::to_named_record(self);\n        let variants = <Self as crate::os_dsl::DslVariants>::variants();\n        let spec_fn = variants.iter().find(|(k, _)| k == &keyword).map(|(_, s)| *s).expect(\"variant spec must exist for its own keyword\");\n        crate::os_dsl::print(&record, &(spec_fn.ordinary)(), crate::os_dsl::JoinMode::Inline)\n    }\n}\n\n/// 📤️ Prints supersede inputs as their indented input lines (see [`SupersedeInputLine`]).\nfn print_supersede_inputs<Op: OpText>(out: &mut String, inputs: &[SupersedeInput<Op>]) -> Result<(), VcsError> {\n    for input in inputs {\n        let line = match &input.replacement {\n            Some(_) => SupersedeInputLine::Replace { target: input.target.0.clone() },\n            None => SupersedeInputLine::Withdraw { target: input.target.0.clone() },\n        };\n        out.push_str(\"  \");\n        out.push_str(&line.print_op());\n        out.push('\\n');\n        if let Some(replacement) = &input.replacement {\n            let printed = replacement.print_op();\n            if printed.contains('\\n') {\n                return Err(VcsError::Serialize(\"op-text print_op must not contain a newline\".into()));\n            }\n            out.push_str(\"    \");\n            out.push_str(&printed);\n            out.push('\\n');\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// 📥️ Parses the indented input lines [`print_supersede_inputs`] prints; at least one input is required. All-or-nothing:\n/// on any failure every replacement parsed so far retires through its technology's cold disposal.\nfn parse_supersede_inputs<P, Op: OpText + self::Mutation<P>>(lines: &[&str]) -> Result<Vec<SupersedeInput<Op>>, TextError> {\n    let mut inputs: Vec<SupersedeInput<Op>> = Vec::new();\n    match parse_supersede_input_lines(lines, &mut inputs) {\n        Ok(()) => Ok(inputs),\n        Err(error) => {\n            retire_supersede_inputs::<P, Op>(inputs);\n            Err(error)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 🧺️ Parses supersede input lines into `inputs`, leaving every parsed input there on failure.\nfn parse_supersede_input_lines<Op: OpText>(lines: &[&str], inputs: &mut Vec<SupersedeInput<Op>>) -> Result<(), TextError> {\n    let mut awaiting_replacement = false;\n    for raw in lines {\n        if let Some(operation) = raw.strip_prefix(\"    \") {\n            if !awaiting_replacement {\n                return Err(crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(format!(\"replacement operation without a replace line: {raw:?}\")));\n            }\n            let input = inputs.last_mut().expect(\"a replace line precedes its replacement\");\n            input.replacement = Some(Op::parse_op(operation.trim())?);\n            awaiting_replacement = false;\n            continue;\n        }\n        if awaiting_replacement {\n            return Err(crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(\"a replace line needs its 4-space-indented replacement operation\"));\n        }\n        let Some(line) = raw.strip_prefix(\"  \") else {\n            return Err(crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(format!(\"expected a 2-space-indented supersede input line, got: {raw:?}\")));\n        };\n        match SupersedeInputLine::parse_op(line.trim())? {\n            SupersedeInputLine::Replace { target } => {\n                inputs.push(SupersedeInput { target: MutationId(target), replacement: None });\n                awaiting_replacement = true;\n            }\n            SupersedeInputLine::Withdraw { target } => inputs.push(SupersedeInput { target: MutationId(target), replacement: None }),\n        }\n    }\n    if awaiting_replacement {\n        return Err(crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(\"a replace line needs its 4-space-indented replacement operation\"));\n    }\n    if inputs.is_empty() {\n        return Err(crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(\"supersede requires at least one input line\"));\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// 🎯️ Binary twin of [`print_supersede_inputs`]: `count varint | (target str | 0 u8 | op len varint | op bytes | 1 u8)*`.\nfn write_supersede_inputs<Op: OpBinary>(out: &mut Vec<u8>, inputs: &[SupersedeInput<Op>]) -> Result<(), crate::os_spr::ProtocolError> {\n    crate::os_pack::write_varint_u64(out, inputs.len() as u64);\n    for input in inputs {\n        write_command_str(out, &input.target.0);\n        match &input.replacement {\n            Some(replacement) => {\n                out.push(0);\n                let bytes = replacement.encode_op()?;\n                crate::os_pack::write_varint_u64(out, bytes.len() as u64);\n                out.extend_from_slice(&bytes);\n            }\n            None => out.push(1),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// 🗳️ Reads a supersede command's inputs all-or-nothing: on any failure every replacement decoded so far retires through\n/// its technology's cold disposal, so a refused command never drops a live operation.\nfn read_supersede_inputs<P, Op: OpBinary + self::Mutation<P>>(reader: &mut crate::os_pack::ByteReader<'_>) -> Result<Vec<SupersedeInput<Op>>, CommandDecodeError> {\n    let count = reader.read_varint_u64()?;\n    let mut inputs = Vec::with_capacity(count.min(reader.remaining() as u64) as usize);\n    for index in 0..count as usize {\n        match read_supersede_input(reader) {\n            Ok(input) => inputs.push(input),\n            Err(error) => {\n                retire_supersede_inputs::<P, Op>(inputs);\n                return Err(match error {\n                    CommandDecodeError::Operation { error, .. } => CommandDecodeError::Operation { index, error },\n                    layout => layout,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(inputs)\n}\n\n/// 🎫️ One supersede input: its target and its replacement operation or withdrawal tag.\nfn read_supersede_input<Op: OpBinary>(reader: &mut crate::os_pack::ByteReader<'_>) -> Result<SupersedeInput<Op>, CommandDecodeError> {\n    let target = MutationId(read_command_str(reader)?);\n    let replacement = match reader.read_u8()? {\n        0 => Some(read_command_op(reader).map_err(|error| CommandDecodeError::Operation { index: 0, error })?),\n        1 => None,\n        tag => return Err(crate::os_spr::ProtocolError::Malformed { what: \"supersede input tag\", offset: reader.position() as u64, detail: format!(\"unknown supersede input tag {tag}\") }.into()),\n    };\n    Ok(SupersedeInput { target, replacement })\n}\n\n//#region 🔖️OpCodec\n/// 🎞️ Handcrafted OpText (P6).\nimpl OpText for CommandHeaderLine {\n    fn parse_op(line: &str) -> Result<Self, TextError> {\n        let variants = <Self as crate::os_dsl::DslVariants>::variants();\n        for (keyword, spec_fn) in &variants {\n            let probe = format!(\"{} \", keyword);\n            if line == keyword.as_str() || line.starts_with(&probe) {\n                let record = crate::os_dsl::parse(line, &(spec_fn.ordinary)(), &crate::os_dsl::ParseOptions { limits: semio_framework_diagnostic::Limits::default(), mode: crate::os_dsl::SourceMode::Inline })?;\n                return <Self as crate::os_dsl::DslVariants>::from_named_record(keyword, &record);\n            }\n        }\n        Err(crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(format!(\"unknown operation line '{line}'\")))\n    }\n    fn print_op(&self) -> String {\n        let (keyword, record) = <Self as crate::os_dsl::DslVariants>::to_named_record(self);\n        let variants = <Self as crate::os_dsl::DslVariants>::variants();\n        let spec_fn = variants.iter().find(|(k, _)| k == &keyword).map(|(_, s)| *s).expect(\"variant spec must exist for its own keyword\");\n        crate::os_dsl::print(&record, &(spec_fn.ordinary)(), crate::os_dsl::JoinMode::Inline)\n    }\n}\n\n/// 🎯️ Handcrafted OpBinary (P6).\nimpl OpBinary for CommandHeaderLine {\n    fn encode_op(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, crate::os_spr::ProtocolError> {\n        const OP_BINARY_FORMAT: u8 = 1;\n        let (keyword, record) = <Self as crate::os_dsl::DslVariants>::to_named_record(self);\n        let variants = <Self as crate::os_dsl::DslVariants>::variants();\n        let ordinal = variants.iter().position(|(k, _)| *k == keyword).ok_or(crate::os_spr::ProtocolError::Malformed { what: \"op variant\", offset: 0, detail: format!(\"keyword {keyword:?} is not a declared variant\") })?;\n        let spec = (variants[ordinal].1.ordinary)();\n        let body = crate::os_pack::encode_record_body(&spec, &record, &PackEncodeOptions::default()).map_err(crate::os_spr::ProtocolError::from)?;\n        let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(body.len() + 3);\n        out.push(OP_BINARY_FORMAT);\n        crate::os_pack::write_varint_u64(&mut out, ordinal as u64);\n        out.extend_from_slice(&body);\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n    fn decode_op(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<Self, crate::os_spr::ProtocolError> {\n        const OP_BINARY_FORMAT: u8 = 1;\n        let mut reader = crate::os_pack::ByteReader::new(bytes);\n        let format = reader.read_u8()?;\n        if format != OP_BINARY_FORMAT {\n            return Err(crate::os_spr::ProtocolError::Malformed { what: \"op format\", offset: 0, detail: format!(\"unsupported op format {format}\") });\n        }\n        let ordinal = reader.read_varint_u64()?;\n        let variants = <Self as crate::os_dsl::DslVariants>::variants();\n        let (keyword, spec_fn) = variants.get(ordinal as usize).ok_or(crate::os_spr::ProtocolError::Malformed { what: \"op variant\", offset: 1, detail: format!(\"ordinal {ordinal} out of range for {} declared variants\", variants.len()) })?;\n        let spec = (spec_fn.ordinary)();\n        let body = &bytes[reader.position()..];\n        let (record, _report) = crate::os_pack::decode_record_body(body, &spec, &PackDecodeOptions::default()).map_err(crate::os_spr::ProtocolError::from)?;\n        let record_offset = reader.position() as u64;\n        <Self as crate::os_dsl::DslVariants>::from_named_record(keyword, &record).map_err(|error| crate::os_spr::ProtocolError::Malformed { what: \"op record\", offset: record_offset, detail: error.to_string() })\n    }\n}\n//#endregion 🔖️OpCodec\n\nasync fn undo_policy_to_token(policy: UndoPolicy) -> &'static str {\n    match policy {\n        UndoPolicy::ExactBaseOnly => \"exact-base-only\",\n        UndoPolicy::TransformAgainstConcurrent => \"transform-against-concurrent\",\n        UndoPolicy::SemanticUndo => \"semantic-undo\",\n        UndoPolicy::CompensatingAction => \"compensating-action\",\n    }\n}\n\nasync fn parse_undo_policy_token(token: &str) -> Result<UndoPolicy, TextError> {\n    match token {\n        \"exact-base-only\" => Ok(UndoPolicy::ExactBaseOnly),\n        \"transform-against-concurrent\" => Ok(UndoPolicy::TransformAgainstConcurrent),\n        \"semantic-undo\" => Ok(UndoPolicy::SemanticUndo),\n        \"compensating-action\" => Ok(UndoPolicy::CompensatingAction),\n        other => Err(crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(format!(\"unknown undo policy token {other:?}\"))),\n    }\n}\n\nfn undo_policy_ordinal(policy: UndoPolicy) -> u8 {\n    match policy {\n        UndoPolicy::ExactBaseOnly => 0,\n        UndoPolicy::TransformAgainstConcurrent => 1,\n        UndoPolicy::SemanticUndo => 2,\n        UndoPolicy::CompensatingAction => 3,\n    }\n}\n\nfn undo_policy_from_ordinal(ordinal: u8) -> Result<UndoPolicy, crate::os_spr::ProtocolError> {\n    match ordinal {\n        0 => Ok(UndoPolicy::ExactBaseOnly),\n        1 => Ok(UndoPolicy::TransformAgainstConcurrent),\n        2 => Ok(UndoPolicy::SemanticUndo),\n        3 => Ok(UndoPolicy::CompensatingAction),\n        other => Err(crate::os_spr::ProtocolError::Malformed { what: \"undo policy ordinal\", offset: 0, detail: format!(\"unknown undo policy ordinal {other}\") }),\n    }\n}\n\n/// 🛤️ `HistoryLane`'s text token — the `ApplyInLane`/`UndoInLane`/\n/// `RedoInLane` command lines' `lane=...` value, mirroring `undo_policy_to_token`'s convention.\nasync fn history_lane_to_token(lane: HistoryLane) -> &'static str {\n    match lane {\n        HistoryLane::Document => \"document\",\n        HistoryLane::Interaction => \"interaction\",\n    }\n}\n\nasync fn parse_history_lane_token(token: &str) -> Result<HistoryLane, TextError> {\n    match token {\n        \"document\" => Ok(HistoryLane::Document),\n        \"interaction\" => Ok(HistoryLane::Interaction),\n        other => Err(crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(format!(\"unknown history lane token {other:?}\"))),\n    }\n}\n\n/// 🛤️ `HistoryLane`'s binary ordinal, mirroring `undo_policy_ordinal`'s convention.\nfn history_lane_ordinal(lane: HistoryLane) -> u8 {\n    match lane {\n        HistoryLane::Document => 0,\n        HistoryLane::Interaction => 1,\n    }\n}\n\nfn history_lane_from_ordinal(ordinal: u8) -> Result<HistoryLane, crate::os_spr::ProtocolError> {\n    match ordinal {\n        0 => Ok(HistoryLane::Document),\n        1 => Ok(HistoryLane::Interaction),\n        other => Err(crate::os_spr::ProtocolError::Malformed { what: \"history lane ordinal\", offset: 0, detail: format!(\"unknown history lane ordinal {other}\") }),\n    }\n}\n\n/// ⚖️ `crate::os_spr::MergePolicy`'s text token — the `SetMergePolicy` command line's\n/// `policy=...` value, mirroring `undo_policy_to_token`'s convention.\nasync fn merge_policy_to_token(policy: crate::os_spr::MergePolicy) -> &'static str {\n    match policy {\n        crate::os_spr::MergePolicy::LaissezFaire => \"laissez-faire\",\n        crate::os_spr::MergePolicy::Normal => \"normal\",\n        crate::os_spr::MergePolicy::Vigilant => \"vigilant\",\n    }\n}\n\nasync fn parse_merge_policy_token(token: &str) -> Result<crate::os_spr::MergePolicy, TextError> {\n    match token {\n        \"laissez-faire\" => Ok(crate::os_spr::MergePolicy::LaissezFaire),\n        \"normal\" => Ok(crate::os_spr::MergePolicy::Normal),\n        \"vigilant\" => Ok(crate::os_spr::MergePolicy::Vigilant),\n        other => Err(crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(format!(\"unknown merge policy token {other:?}\"))),\n    }\n}\n\n/// ⚔️ `crate::os_spr::ConflictResolution`'s text token — the `ResolveConflict` command line's\n/// `resolution=...` value, mirroring `undo_policy_to_token`'s convention.\nasync fn conflict_resolution_to_token(resolution: crate::os_spr::ConflictResolution) -> &'static str {\n    match resolution {\n        crate::os_spr::ConflictResolution::Accept => \"accept\",\n        crate::os_spr::ConflictResolution::Discard => \"discard\",\n    }\n}\n\nasync fn parse_conflict_resolution_token(token: &str) -> Result<crate::os_spr::ConflictResolution, TextError> {\n    match token {\n        \"accept\" => Ok(crate::os_spr::ConflictResolution::Accept),\n        \"discard\" => Ok(crate::os_spr::ConflictResolution::Discard),\n        other => Err(crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(format!(\"unknown conflict resolution token {other:?}\"))),\n    }\n}\n\n/// ⚔️ `crate::os_spr::ConflictResolution`'s binary ordinal, mirroring\n/// `undo_policy_ordinal`'s convention.\nfn conflict_resolution_ordinal(resolution: crate::os_spr::ConflictResolution) -> u8 {\n    match resolution {\n        crate::os_spr::ConflictResolution::Accept => 0,\n        crate::os_spr::ConflictResolution::Discard => 1,\n    }\n}\n\nfn conflict_resolution_from_ordinal(ordinal: u8) -> Result<crate::os_spr::ConflictResolution, crate::os_spr::ProtocolError> {\n    match ordinal {\n        0 => Ok(crate::os_spr::ConflictResolution::Accept),\n        1 => Ok(crate::os_spr::ConflictResolution::Discard),\n        other => Err(crate::os_spr::ProtocolError::Malformed { what: \"conflict resolution ordinal\", offset: 0, detail: format!(\"unknown conflict resolution ordinal {other}\") }),\n    }\n}\n\n/// 📤️ Prints every 2-space-indented `Op::print_op` line for one `apply`/`amend` body,\n/// erroring exactly like `print_edit_lines` if any op prints a line containing a newline.\nasync fn print_indented_ops<Op: OpText>(out: &mut String, mutations: &[Op]) -> Result<(), VcsError> {\n    for mutation in mutations {\n        let printed = mutation.print_op();\n        if printed.contains('\\n') {\n            return Err(VcsError::Serialize(\"op-text print_op must not contain a newline\".into()));\n        }\n        out.push_str(\"  \");\n        out.push_str(&printed);\n        out.push('\\n');\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// 📥️ Parses every already-2-space-indented body line of an `apply`/`amend` command as one\n/// operation each — the command-level twin of `replay_ops`'s indented-op-line branch.\n/// All-or-nothing: on any failure every operation parsed so far retires through its technology's cold disposal.\nasync fn parse_indented_ops<P, Op: OpText + self::Mutation<P>>(body_lines: &[&str]) -> Result<Vec<Op>, TextError> {\n    let mut mutations = Vec::with_capacity(body_lines.len());\n    for raw in body_lines {\n        let parsed = match raw.starts_with(\"  \") {\n            true => Op::parse_op(raw.trim()),\n            false => Err(crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(format!(\"expected a 2-space-indented op line, got: {raw:?}\"))),\n        };\n        match parsed {\n            Ok(operation) => mutations.push(operation),\n            Err(error) => {\n                retire_operations::<P, Op>(mutations);\n                return Err(error);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(mutations)\n}\n\n/// 📥️ Strips exactly one 2-space indent level from every line, joining them back into a\n/// standalone command text — used to recurse `parse_command` into a `semantic-undo`/\n/// `compensating-action` nested command block.\nasync fn dedent_command_lines(lines: &[&str]) -> Result<String, TextError> {\n    let mut out = String::new();\n    for raw in lines {\n        if !raw.starts_with(\"  \") {\n            return Err(crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(format!(\"expected a 2-space-indented nested command line, got: {raw:?}\")));\n        }\n        out.push_str(&raw[2..]);\n        out.push('\\n');\n    }\n    Ok(out)\n}\n\n/// 📤️ Prints a `ArtifactCommand` as its one-line-per-structural-field header, plus any\n/// 2-space-indented operation lines (`Apply`) or a further-indented nested command\n/// block (`UndoWithPolicy`'s `semantic_command`) — the maximum-token-efficient textual twin of\n/// `encode_command`. `Author::avatar` is never printed, mirroring `OpsAuthor`'s `by=[...]` law.\npub async fn print_command<Op: OpText>(command: &ArtifactCommand<Op>) -> Result<String, VcsError> {\n    let mut out = String::new();\n    match command {\n        ArtifactCommand::Apply { mutations, description, transaction } => {\n            let (transaction, tool) = transaction_text(transaction.as_ref());\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::Apply { description: description.clone(), transaction, tool }.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n            print_indented_ops(&mut out, mutations).await?;\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::Undo => {\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::Undo { policy: None }.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::Redo => {\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::Redo.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::UndoWithPolicy { policy, semantic_command } => {\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::Undo { policy: Some(undo_policy_to_token(*policy).await.to_string()) }.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n            if let Some(nested) = semantic_command {\n                let nested_text = Box::pin(print_command(nested)).await?;\n                for line in nested_text.lines() {\n                    out.push_str(\"  \");\n                    out.push_str(line);\n                    out.push('\\n');\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::CommitCheckpoint { message, authors } => {\n            let header = CommandHeaderLine::CommitCheckpoint { message: message.clone(), by: authors.iter().map(OpsAuthor::from).collect() };\n            out.push_str(&header.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::CreateAlternative { name } => {\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::CreateAlternative { name: name.clone() }.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::SwitchAlternative { alternative_id } => {\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::SwitchAlternative { id: alternative_id.clone() }.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::CheckoutCheckpoint { checkpoint_id } => {\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::Checkout { id: checkpoint_id.clone() }.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::ApplyInLane { mutations, description, lane, transaction } => {\n            let (transaction, tool) = transaction_text(transaction.as_ref());\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::ApplyInLane { description: description.clone(), lane: history_lane_to_token(*lane).await.to_string(), transaction, tool }.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n            print_indented_ops(&mut out, mutations).await?;\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::UndoInLane { lane } => {\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::UndoInLane { lane: history_lane_to_token(*lane).await.to_string() }.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::RedoInLane { lane } => {\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::RedoInLane { lane: history_lane_to_token(*lane).await.to_string() }.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::IngestRemote { .. } => {\n            return Err(VcsError::Serialize(\"IngestRemote has no text command form\".into()));\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::PruneDrafts => {\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::PruneDrafts.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::SetMergePolicy { policy } => {\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::SetMergePolicy { policy: merge_policy_to_token(*policy).await.to_string() }.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::ResolveConflict { conflict_id, resolution } => {\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::ResolveConflict { conflict_id: conflict_id.clone(), resolution: conflict_resolution_to_token(*resolution).await.to_string() }.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::Supersede { scope, inputs } => {\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::Supersede { scope: scope.clone() }.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n            print_supersede_inputs(&mut out, inputs)?;\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::CreateAlternativeWithSupersede { name, inputs } => {\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::CreateAlternativeWithSupersede { name: name.clone() }.print_op());\n out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::AppendTransaction { transaction: transaction.id.clone(), tool: transaction.tool.clone() }.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n            print_indented_ops(&mut out, mutations).await?;\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::CommitTransaction { transaction_id } => {\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::CommitTransaction { id: transaction_id.clone() }.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n        }\n        ArtifactCommand::AbortTransaction { transaction_id } => {\n            out.push_str(&CommandHeaderLine::AbortTransaction { id: transaction_id.clone() }.print_op());\n            out.push('\\n');\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(out)\n}\n\n/// 📥️ Parses a `print_command`-produced (or hand-authored) command text back into a\n/// `ArtifactCommand`. LAW: `parse_command(&print_command(c)?) == Ok(c)` for every `c`.\npub async fn parse_command<P, Op: OpText + self::Mutation<P>>(text: &str) -> Result<ArtifactCommand<Op>, TextError> {\n    let all_lines: Vec<&str> = text.lines().collect();\n    let mut header: Option<(u32, &str)> = None;\n    let mut body_start = all_lines.len();\n    for (index, raw) in all_lines.iter().enumerate() {\n        let trimmed = raw.trim();\n        if trimmed.is_empty() || trimmed.starts_with('#') {\n            continue;\n        }\n        header = Some((index as u32 + 1, trimmed));\n        body_start = index + 1;\n        break;\n    }\n    let (header_line_no, header_text) = header.ok_or_else(|| crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(\"empty command text\"))?;\n    let header_line = CommandHeaderLine::parse_op(header_text).map_err(|error| TextError { span: TextSpan::at(header_line_no, error.span.column), ..error })?;\n    let body_lines: Vec<&str> = all_lines[body_start..].iter().filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty() && !line.trim().starts_with('#')).copied().collect();\n\n    match header_line {\n        CommandHeaderLine::Apply { description, transaction, tool } => {\n            let transaction = transaction_from_text(transaction, tool)?;\n            let mutations = parse_indented_ops::<P, Op>(&body_lines).await?;\n            if mutations.is_empty() {\n                return Err(crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(\"apply requires at least one operation line\"));\n            }\n            Ok(ArtifactCommand::Apply { mutations, description, transaction })\n        }\n        CommandHeaderLine::Undo { policy: None } => Ok(ArtifactCommand::Undo),\n        CommandHeaderLine::Undo { policy: Some(token) } => {\n            let policy = parse_undo_policy_token(&token).await?;\n            let semantic_command = if body_lines.is_empty() {\n                None\n            } else {\n                let dedented = dedent_command_lines(&body_lines).await?;\n                Some(Box::new(Box::pin(parse_command::<P, Op>(&dedented)).await?))\n            };\n            Ok(ArtifactCommand::UndoWithPolicy { policy, semantic_command })\n        }\n        CommandHeaderLine::Redo => Ok(ArtifactCommand::Redo),\n        CommandHeaderLine::CommitCheckpoint { message, by } => Ok(ArtifactCommand::CommitCheckpoint { message, authors: by.into_iter().map(Author::from).collect() }),\n        CommandHeaderLine::CreateAlternative { name } => Ok(ArtifactCommand::CreateAlternative { name }),\n        CommandHeaderLine::SwitchAlternative { id } => Ok(ArtifactCommand::SwitchAlternative { alternative_id: id }),\n        CommandHeaderLine::Checkout { id } => Ok(ArtifactCommand::CheckoutCheckpoint { checkpoint_id: id }),\n        CommandHeaderLine::PruneDrafts => Ok(ArtifactCommand::PruneDrafts),\n        CommandHeaderLine::ApplyInLane { description, lane, transaction, tool } => {\n            let transaction = transaction_from_text(transaction, tool)?;\n            let lane = parse_history_lane_token(&lane).await?;\n            let mutations = parse_indented_ops::<P, Op>(&body_lines).await?;\n            if mutations.is_empty() {\n                return Err(crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(\"apply-in-lane requires at least one operation line\"));\n            }\n CommandHeaderLine::SetMergePolicy { policy } => Ok(ArtifactCommand::SetMergePolicy { policy: parse_merge_policy_token(&policy).await? }),\n        CommandHeaderLine::ResolveConflict { conflict_id, resolution } => Ok(ArtifactCommand::ResolveConflict { conflict_id, resolution: parse_conflict_resolution_token(&resolution).await? }),\n        CommandHeaderLine::Supersede { scope } => Ok(ArtifactCommand::Supersede { scope, inputs: parse_supersede_inputs::<P, Op>(&body_lines)? }),\n        CommandHeaderLine::CreateAlternativeWithSupersede { name } => Ok(ArtifactCommand::CreateAlternativeWithSupersede { name, inputs: parse_supersede_inputs::<P, Op>(&body_lines)? }),\n        CommandHeaderLine::AppendTransaction { transaction, tool } => {\n least one operation line\"));\n            }\n            Ok(ArtifactCommand::AppendTransaction { mutations, transaction: protocol::TransactionRef { id: transaction, tool } })\n        }\n Ok(ArtifactCommand::AbortTransaction { transaction_id: id }),\n    }\n}\n\n/// 🧾️ A transaction reference as its two text attributes.\nfn transaction_text(transaction: Option<&protocol::TransactionRef>) -> (Option<String>, Option<String>) {\n    match transaction {\n        Some(transaction) => (Some(transaction.id.clone()), Some(transaction.tool.clone())),\n        None => (None, None),\n    }\n}\n\n/// 🧾️ Inverse of [`transaction_text`]: both attributes or neither.\nfn transaction_from_text(transaction: Option<String>, tool: Option<String>) -> Result<Option<protocol::TransactionRef>, TextError> {\n    match (transaction, tool) {\n        (Some(id), Some(tool)) => Ok(Some(protocol::TransactionRef { id, tool })),\n        (None, None) => Ok(None),\n        _ => Err(crate::os_dsl::__rt::field_error(\"a transaction needs both its id and its tool\")),\n    }\n}\n\n/// 🧾️ Binary twin of [`transaction_text`]: the id and tool strings after a `0b10` presence bit.\nfn write_command_transaction(out: &mut Vec<u8>, transaction: Option<&protocol::TransactionRef>) {\n    if let Some(transaction) = transaction {\n        write_command_str(out, &transaction.id);\n        write_command_str(out, &transaction.tool);\n    }\n}\n\nfn read_command_transaction(reader: &mut crate::os_pack::ByteReader<'_>, presence: u8) -> Result<Option<protocol::TransactionRef>, crate::os_spr::ProtocolError> {\n    if presence & 0b10 == 0 {\n        return Ok(None);\n    }\n    let id = read_command_str(reader)?;\n    let tool = read_command_str(reader)?;\n    Ok(Some(protocol::TransactionRef { id, tool }))\n}\n\n/// 🎯️ Format byte every encoded command starts with — matches `crate::os_dsl::op_rt::OP_BINARY_FORMAT`\n/// (B-R6 \"one wire convention\": `format u8 | ordinal varint | record body`).\npub const COMMAND_BINARY_FORMAT: u8 = 1;\n\nfn write_command_str(out: &mut Vec<u8>, s: &str) {\n    crate::os_pack::write_varint_u64(out, s.len() as u64);\n    out.extend_from_slice(s.as_bytes());\n}\n\nfn read_command_str(reader: &mut crate::os_pack::ByteReader<'_>) -> Result<String, crate::os_spr::ProtocolError> {\n    let len = reader.read_varint_u64()?;\n    let bytes = reader.read_bytes(len as usize)?;\n    std::str::from_utf8(bytes).map(str::to_string).map_err(|error| crate::os_spr::ProtocolError> {\n    crate::os_pack::write_varint_u64(out, mutations.len() as u64);\n    for mutation in mutations {\n        let bytes = mutation.encode_op()?;\n
